title: Baton: from idea to reviewed, tested code with an agent orchestrator
excerpt: An open-source orchestrator that routes work across Claude Code, Codex and OpenRouter models through plan, validate, code, test and integrate stages.
content:
The problem

AI coding agents are fast, but left alone they skip planning, review and tests. Teams end up babysitting each run instead of shipping.

The approach

Baton (the jev CLI plus a web dashboard) treats every idea as a job that moves through plan → validate → code → test → integrate. Each stage is dispatched to the provider best suited to it, whether Claude Code, Codex or OpenRouter models (free ones included), with cost-aware routing and a quality gate before anything merges.

  • Autonomy modes from fully supervised to hands-off
  • Idea queue, scheduler and Kanban board, plus a fleet view across runs
  • Per-role MCP tools and skills, and recursive learning profiles that improve routing over time
  • Browser preview with human takeover

The result

Work arrives as reviewed, tested pull requests instead of raw diffs. The orchestrator is public on GitHub.
